findings.description: When CRM configuration contains empty entities list, function silently defaults primary_entity to 'lead' instead of returning a clear error. Lines 778 and 781 both have 'lead' fallback values.
findings.code:
primary_entity = "lead" # Line 778
primary_entity = entities[0].get("name", "lead") # Line 781 fallback
findings.consequence: Evolution proposals silently reference incorrect entity when CRM config is malformed; errors are masked
findings.requirement: C4: If the entity cannot be resolved, return a clear, actionable error
findings.tested_behavior: Empty entities list produces proposal with entity='lead' instead of error
findings.correction: Remove hard-coded fallback and raise ValueError with actionable message when entities cannot be resolved
